notes: Building multi-user library system on top of existing DBB MTG card app. Stack: Next.js 14, Supabase Auth, Tailwind. No homepage - auth wall routes to /library.

tasks.title: Supabase schema: user_profiles, user_cards, binders, binder_cards
tasks.notes: RLS policies for all tables. user_cards references scryfall_id only — don't duplicate card data. Cache card_name, set_code, collector_number for fast queries.

tasks.title: Next.js Supabase server client + auth middleware
tasks.notes: Server-side Supabase client using @supabase/ssr. Middleware protects /library /profile routes. Unauthenticated → /login. Authenticated + visiting / → /library.

tasks.title: Auth pages: /login, /register, /auth/confirm
tasks.notes: DBB-branded. No social login yet. Email+password. After register: email confirm flow. After login: redirect to /library. Supabase email templates with DBB branding.

tasks.title: User library page /library — card grid with sort/filter/star/delete
tasks.notes: Fetch user_cards for logged-in user. Sort: name/set/added_at/starred. Filter: set/color/rarity/foil/condition/starred. Actions: star toggle, delete, add to binder. Empty state CTA to search+add cards.

tasks.title: Scryfall advanced search overlay for adding cards
tasks.notes: Search Scryfall API (via existing /api/scryfall or new proxy). Show results with card image. Click → open AddCardModal with condition/foil/quantity/notes fields. POST to /api/library/cards.

tasks.title: Library API routes: /api/library/cards (CRUD)
tasks.notes: GET list, POST add, PATCH update (star/condition/notes), DELETE. Use Supabase server client with user session. Validate ownership before write.

tasks.title: Binder collections: list, create, view, add/remove cards
tasks.notes: Auto-create 'General' default binder on first login. /library/binders lists all binders. /library/binders/[id] shows cards in binder. Multi-select cards in library → add to binder.

tasks.title: ManaBox CSV bulk upload: parser + API endpoint
tasks.notes: ManaBox CSV columns: Name,Edition,Edition code,Collector number,Foil,Quantity,Purchase price,Misprint,Altered,Condition,Language,Purchase price currency. Map to user_cards. Batch Scryfall lookups by (set_code + collector_number) to get scryfall_id. Batch insert.

tasks.title: Bulk upload UI: CSV drop/select, preview table, binder assignment prompt
tasks.notes: Drag-and-drop or file picker. Parse CSV client-side for preview (first 10 rows shown). On confirm: POST to /api/library/bulk-upload. After success: modal asks 'Add to General binder or create new binder?'.

tasks.title: User profile page /profile — summary stats + edit
tasks.notes: Stats: total unique cards, total quantity, sets represented, top colors, starred count, binder count. Edit: display_name, avatar_url. Deactivate account option (soft delete: is_active=false in user_profiles, Supabase admin disable).

tasks.title: DBB-branded Supabase email templates
tasks.notes: Confirm signup, reset password, magic link. Use DBB color scheme (dbb-primary/accent from tailwind.config). Plain HTML, inline styles. Update via Supabase Dashboard > Auth > Email Templates.

tasks.title: Navigation, layout shell, user menu
tasks.notes: Top nav: DBB logo, Library / Binders / Profile links, user avatar dropdown (Profile, Sign out). Mobile: hamburger. Wrap all authenticated pages. Current page /library keeps existing DBB dark theme.

context.tech_stack: Next.js 14 App Router, Supabase, Tailwind CSS, lucide-react
